name: CAQH ProView
description: CAQH ProView is the industry-standard universal provider data repository that allows healthcare providers to maintain their professional, practice, and credentialing information in a single, secure location. Used by over 1.4 million healthcare providers, it streamlines the credentialing process by enabling providers to self-report data once and share it with multiple health plans and healthcare organizations.

pricing.free_tier_details: Free for all healthcare providers - costs covered by participating health plans
pricing.notes: CAQH ProView is free for healthcare providers. Health plans and healthcare organizations pay subscription fees to access provider data. There is no cost for providers to create, maintain, or attest to their CAQH profile.

company.legal_name: Council for Affordable Quality Healthcare, Inc.
company.description: CAQH is a non-profit alliance of health plans and trade associations that creates shared initiatives to streamline healthcare administration. ProView is their flagship provider credentialing solution.

compliance.notes: CAQH maintains rigorous data security standards and is widely recognized as the industry standard for provider credentialing data

faqs.question: Is CAQH ProView free for providers?
faqs.answer: Yes, CAQH ProView is completely free for healthcare providers. The costs are covered by participating health plans and healthcare organizations who pay to access the provider data. Providers can create, maintain, and attest to their profiles at no charge.

faqs.question: How often do I need to re-attest my CAQH profile?
faqs.answer: CAQH requires providers to re-attest (review and confirm) their profile information every 120 days (approximately every 4 months). Re-attestation typically takes 30-60 minutes and ensures your credentialing data remains current and accurate.

faqs.question: What information do I need to complete my CAQH ProView profile?
faqs.answer: You'll need: professional licenses, DEA registration, board certifications, malpractice insurance information, work history (past 5-10 years), education and training history, hospital affiliations, practice location details, and professional references. Having documents ready can speed up the initial 2-4 hour setup.

faqs.question: How does CAQH ProView speed up insurance credentialing?
faqs.answer: Instead of completing separate applications for each health plan, you enter your information once in CAQH ProView. When you apply for credentialing with participating health plans (which includes most major insurers), they pull your verified data directly from CAQH, reducing paperwork and processing time significantly.
